# regapi_domain_registration (Resource)

The one-time act of registering a domain. If the order is not paid the apply fails with the payment instructions; pay, then apply again. Afterwards manage the domain with regapi_domain. Changes to this resource after registration are not applied, and destroying it does not deregister the domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "regapi_domain_quote" "client" {
  domain_name = "client.gr"
}

resource "regapi_domain_registration" "client" {
  domain_name          = "client.gr"
  expected_price_cents = data.regapi_domain_quote.client.price_cents
  wait_for_active      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The name to register, for example acme.gr.

### Optional

- `admin_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the administrative contact. Left out: the account's default for the role.
- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Initial auto-renew.
- `billing_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the billing contact. Left out: the account's default for the role.
- `expected_price_cents` (Number) The price guard: if the price differs, nothing is charged and the apply fails with price_changed. Take it from regapi_domain_quote.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Initial nameservers. Left out: the registrar's defaults.
- `payment_method` (String) saved_card or checkout. Left out: the saved card if there is one.
- `registrant_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the registrant contact. Left out: the account's default for the role.
- `tech_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the technical contact. Left out: the account's default for the role.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_active` (Boolean) Wait until the domain is Active (see timeouts.create).
- `years` (Number) Term in years. Left out: the TLD's minimum term.

### Read-Only

- `amount_cents` (Number) What the order costs, in cents.
- `order_id` (String) The registration order.
- `order_state` (String) State of the order when last read.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
